agent_priors_used: Local-optimum trap in synthetic tuning: repeated estimator hyperparameter search (TV/KDE/kNN, bandwidth, alpha) on same synthetic DGP yields diminishing information once per-function heterogeneity is established; next high-value step is distribution shift to correlated or real data, not another bandwidth - used to pivot physics/frontier/runtime away from estimator tuning (SPIDER evidence: frontier 44+ streak yielding FALSIFIED per-function heterogeneity, not live evidence).

Cache invalidation harder than caching: DOM-hash validation (Stagehand) catches structural drift but not semantic drift (auth, permission, body JSON field); parameterized mechanisms must be tested with mixed header+body+query aliasing and orthogonal behavioral-structural freshness - used to prioritize mixed-channel reconstruction and to frame Stagehand 2x speedup/~30% cost as the strong baseline SPIDER must beat (SPIDER evidence: C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE synthetic 1.0 vs verbatim 1.0 gap, not live).

Compounding planning errors over long horizons (11+ steps, Online-Mind2Web hard split) make residual-novelty amortized cost dominated by verification/repair loops, not execution length - predicts retrieval cost alone will not show savings without parallel-channel verification and honest f=10 amortization - used to require product residual-novelty to measure tokens+browser+verify+repair vs cold/RAG/Stagehand with calibrated UNKNOWN (SPIDER evidence: prior residual-novelty experiments were bijective formulas with zero variance, not measurements).

Tool/API bypass dominance: many browsing tasks are shortcut via direct endpoints/tools when available (WebMCP/Fetch); discovery of endpoint+method+auth scope is higher-leverage inheritance than DOM selector caching - used to justify frontier WebAPI endpoint mining as orthogonal high-upside alternative to further DOM alias tuning (SPIDER evidence: no product WebAPI evidence yet).

Path dependence and salience: LLM agents over-sample recent trajectory context and anchor on first retrieved mechanism; without calibrated UNKNOWN abstention they over-apply stale mechanisms (false_accept) - motivates ECE and abstention calibration in all semantic/residual allocations (SPIDER evidence: C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE ECE 0.065 synthetic, but live UNKNOWN 0/0).
